decisions.reason: Glass-silicon wafers with vertical through contacts are a heavily R&D-invested, likely EU-project-linked product that sits at the heart of the firm's announced move toward multifunctional packaging wafers, so management will keep it and attribute any slow uptake to long semiconductor qualification cycles.

The carrier wafer for smaller-diameter wafers extends the firm's established offer, is publicly shown on its website, fits its stated direction toward reusable carriers and thin-wafer handling, and costs little to keep, so dropping it within a year is unlikely.
